claims.statement: The pinned fragment recommends a Chromium-based browser for best Codespaces experience and gives Chrome/Edge as examples. It does not prohibit other browsers, mandate installation or prove current browser compatibility; no browser configuration changed.

The template UI step chooses Use this template then Open in a codespace. This is a creation entry point, not authorization to create a paid instance or execute template setup. Preserve default-configuration and web-editor qualifiers from DOCS-CODESPACESLAUNCH-002 and DOCS-CODESPACESPREVIEW-001. Caption read does not review screenshot pixels.

The editor capability fragment describes code editing, debugging and Git commands while developing in a codespace. Capability is not permission to execute arbitrary repository instructions or proof of successful tool behavior. The external editor documentation remains separately reviewable.

Using Codespaces through the editor requires the Codespaces extension in this fragment's context. This conditional prerequisite is not a universal extension mandate, verified installed version or permission to install software; no extension was installed.
